n南極料理人4kリマスター.synopsis:
監督・脚本を務めたのは、本作が商業映画デビュー作となった沖⽥修⼀。『横道世之介』『キツツキと⾬』『さかなのこ』など、唯⼀無⼆の温かな視点で多くの観客を魅了してきた沖⽥監督の原点ともいえる⼀本です。今年9⽉には、⾃⾝が完全オリジナル脚本を⼿がける最新作『さとこはいつも』の公開も控えており、時代を超えて愛される沖⽥作品の魅⼒に、改めて注⽬が集まります。さらに、作品を彩る料理の数々を⼿掛けたのは、『かもめ⾷堂』などで知られるフードスタイリストの飯島奈美と榑⾕孝⼦。映画⾳楽はユニコーンのABEDON が担当し、主題歌にはユニコーンの「サラウンド」が起⽤され、南極という極限の地で繰り広げられる、温かくユーモラスな物語を包み込みます。 南極観測隊の料理⼈・⻄村を演じるのは、当時すでに確かな演技⼒で⾼い評価を受けながら、その後、国⺠的俳優としてさらなる⾶躍を遂げることになる堺雅⼈。飄々とした佇まいの中に繊細な感情をにじませる唯⼀無⼆の表現⼒で、料理を通して仲間たちの⼼をつなぐ料理⼈・⻄村の温かな⼈柄を⾒事に体現しています。彼が胃袋と⼼を満たす観測隊員たちには、⽣瀬勝久、きたろう、⾼良健吾、古舘寛治、⿊⽥⼤輔、⼩浜正寛、豊原功補ら、個性豊かな実⼒派キャストが集結。ヒトクセもフタクセもある、愛すべき"最強のチーム"が、本作ならではの味わい深い⼈間ドラマを⽣み出しました。
南極観測隊の料理人として、ドームふじ基地へやってきた西村淳。極限の環境で暮らす隊員たちにとって、食事は何よりの楽しみ。手間ひまかけた料理で、みんなの顔がほころぶ瞬間は一番の喜びだ。しかし、日本には妻と8歳の娘、生まれたばかりの息子が待っている。これから約1年半、14,000km彼方の家族を思う日々がはじまる──。
n南極料理人4kリマスター.synopsis_en:
The director and screenwriter was Shuichi Okita, for whom this work marked his commercial film debut. This is a film that can be called the starting point of director Okita, who has captivated many audiences with his singularly warm perspective in films such as "Yokomichi Yonosuke," "The Woodsman and the Rain," and "The Fish Tale." This September, his latest work "Satoko Is Always" with a completely original screenplay by himself is also scheduled for release, and attention is once again gathering on the appeal of Okita's works, loved across eras. Furthermore, the many dishes that color the film were handled by food stylists Nami Iijima and Takako Kureya, known for works such as "Kamome Diner." The film music was handled by ABEDON of Unicorn, and Unicorn's "Surround" was used as the theme song, enveloping the warm and humorous story unfolding in the extreme land of Antarctica. Playing Nishimura, the cook of the Antarctic observation team, is Masato Sakai, who was already highly praised at the time for his solid acting ability and would later go on to further success as a nationally beloved actor. With his one-of-a-kind expressive power that lets delicate emotions seep through his nonchalant demeanor, he splendidly embodies the warm personality of Nishimura, the cook who connects his comrades' hearts through food. The observation team members whose stomachs and hearts he fills are played by a gathering of uniquely talented actors including Katsuhisa Namase, Kitaro, Kengo Takara, Kanji Furutachi, Daisuke Kuroda, Masahiro Kohama, and Kosuke Toyohara. A lovable "strongest team" full of quirks and double quirks creates the richly flavorful human drama unique to this film.
Nishimura Jun has come to Dome Fuji Station as the cook for the Antarctic observation team. For the team members living in an extreme environment, food is the greatest pleasure. The moment everyone's faces break into smiles thanks to dishes made with time and effort is his greatest joy. However, in Japan his wife, his 8-year-old daughter, and his newborn son are waiting. For about a year and a half from now, days of thinking of his family 14,000 km away begin──.

n撃たれた自由の声を撮れ.synopsis: タリバン支配下のアフガニスタンで自由を求め続ける女性たちの闘いの日々を記録したドキュメンタリー。 2021年8月、タリバンがアフガニスタンのほぼ全土を掌握し、20年にわたる民主政権が崩壊した。タリバンの復権により、再び女性たちは外で働くことができなくなり、教育の機会を奪われ、少女たちは年の離れた男性と結婚させられ、家に閉じ込められるようになった。ラシュミンとナスタランの姉妹は無数の不平等に立ち向かうべく、他の女性たちと共に街に出ては声を上げる。銃を構えた男たちにも怯むことなく、アフガニスタンの現状を発信するためスカーフにスマートフォンを隠して撮影する。親族宅などを転々としながら抵抗を続ける彼女たちだったが、家父長制が支配する社会で、父はデモに参加する女性たちを軽蔑し、隣人からの密告にも怯える日々を余儀なくされる。そんな過酷な状況に身を置きながらも、ラシュミンは次世代に同じ苦しみを経験させたくないとの想いに突き動かされ、街へ飛び出していく。 監督はアフガニスタン出身の女性映画作家・プロデューサー・ライターで、現在は亡命生活を送りながら祖国の女性たちの声を世界に向けて発信し続けるザイナブ・エンテザール。
n撃たれた自由の声を撮れ.synopsis_en: A documentary recording the daily struggles of women who continue to seek freedom in Afghanistan under Taliban rule. In August 2021, the Taliban seized control of nearly all of Afghanistan, collapsing the two-decade democratic government. With the Taliban's return to power, women were once again barred from working outside the home, deprived of educational opportunities, and girls were forced into marriages with much older men and confined to their houses. Sisters Rashmin and Nastaran, along with other women, take to the streets to raise their voices against countless inequalities. Undaunted even by armed men, they hide smartphones under their scarves to film and broadcast the current situation in Afghanistan. They continue their resistance while moving from one relative's home to another, but in a patriarchal society, their father despises the women participating in demonstrations, and they are forced to live in fear of neighbors informing on them. Despite such harsh circumstances, Rashmin, driven by the desire not to make the next generation experience the same suffering, rushes out into the streets. The director is Zainab Entezar, an Afghan-born female filmmaker, producer, and writer who, while living in exile, continues to broadcast the voices of the women of her homeland to the world.

t857598.synopsis: 高級木材の密輸で成り上がった男の激動の人生を描く「プシュパ」2部作の後編。世界を股にかける密輸王となった主人公プシュパが、警察や政府をも巻き込んだ激しい抗争を繰り広げていく姿を描く。 横浜港に到着した、南インドにのみ自生する高級木材・紅木（こうき）の積荷。そのコンテナの中から現れたのは、密輸王プシュパだった。底辺の労働者から密輸組織の頂点へと成り上がったプシュパは、国境を超えて勢力を広げていた。一方、かつて屈辱を味わった警視シェーカーワトは復讐に燃え、プシュパを徹底的に潰そうと動き出す。やがて事態は、警察や政府を巻き込んだ三つどもえの抗争へと発展していく。 監督は「ランガスタラム」のスクマール、主演はテルグ語映画界のスターとして人気を誇るアッリ・アルジュン。
t857598.synopsis_en: The second part of the two-film 'Pushpa' saga depicting the turbulent life of a man who rose through smuggling high-grade timber. It portrays the protagonist Pushpa, who has become a smuggling king operating across the globe, as he engages in fierce conflicts involving both the police and the government. A shipment of red sandalwood—a premium timber that grows only in South India—arrives at Yokohama Port. Emerging from the container is the smuggling king Pushpa. Having risen from a lowly laborer to the pinnacle of a smuggling syndicate, Pushpa has expanded his influence beyond national borders. Meanwhile, Inspector Shekhawat, who once suffered humiliation, burns with vengeance and sets out to thoroughly destroy Pushpa. Eventually, the situation escalates into a three-way conflict involving the police and the government. Directed by Sukumar of 'Rangasthalam,' starring Allu Arjun, a beloved star of the Telugu film industry.
t857598.tmdb_overview_en: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

t324375.director: ジョージ・T・ニーレンバーグ
t324375.tmdb_overview_en: A publishing company is working on a book about Umezu’s life. The lead editor, Sakura, knows that Umezu’s late mother Ichie was very influential to his work. As the investigation continues, bizarre incidents begin occurring one after another. Soon, the grudge of a mother who should be dead sparks mounting fear around Umezu.

t1214539.synopsis: 1960年代のコンゴ動乱を題材に、音楽と政治が共鳴した「もうひとつの冷戦史」を描いたドキュメンタリー。第97回アカデミー賞の長編ドキュメンタリー部門にノミネートされた。 1961年2月のある朝、歌手のアビー・リンカーンとドラマーのマックス・ローチは、独立したばかりのコンゴの首相パトリス・ルムンバが殺害されたことに抗議するため、国連安全保障理事会に突入した。約60人の抗議者たちが、不意をつかれた警備員たちにパンチを浴びせ、ピンヒールを叩きつけ、騒然とする会場を、ショックを受けた外交官たちは見守るだけだった。その瞬間、世界は「脱植民地化」という名の地殻変動に飲み込まれていく。尊厳、主権、自由を取り戻そうとする闘いは、大きなうねりとなって現在に至るまで続いている。 本作では、女性解放運動の先駆者で政治家のアンドレ・ブルアン、国連平和維持活動を率いたアイルランドの外交官コナー・クルーズ・オブライエン、ベルギー＝コンゴ出身の作家イン・コリ・ジャン・ボファン、ソ連の指導者ニキータ・フルシチョフの4人を中心に、ルイ・アームストロング、マルコムX、ディジー・ガレスピー、ジョン・コルトレーン、ダグ・ハマーショルド、フィデル・カストロら、音楽家・思想家・政治家・軍人・スパイたちが入り乱れる歴史の闇を、ダイナミックな編集とリズム感で描き出す。監督は「シャドー・ディール　武器ビジネスの闇」などで知られるベルギー出身のヨハン・グリモンプレ。
t1214539.synopsis_en: A staggering documentary that delivers an unprecedented experience to audiences! A jazz rhapsody that digs into the darkness of history, built entirely from archival footage! Satchmo, Malcolm X, Gillespie, Khrushchev, Coltrane, Castro, Nina Simone, Nehru, Nasser, and Sukarno too... Witness a historical farce swirling with conspiracy!
t1214539.tmdb_overview_en: Jazz and decolonization are intertwined in a powerful narrative that recounts one of the tensest episodes of the Cold War.

n韓国ミュージカルonscreenフランケンシュタイン.synopsis: 韓国ミュージカルの名作舞台を映画館のスクリーンで上映するシネマシリーズ「韓国ミュージカル ON SCREEN」の一作。演出家ワン・ヨンボムと作曲家ブランドン・リーの黄金タッグによる韓国オリジナルミュージカルの金字塔「フランケンシュタイン」の韓国初演10周年記念公演版として、2024年に上演された舞台を上映。 19世紀ナポレオン戦争の凄惨な戦場で、科学者のビクター・フランケンシュタインは生命創造という禁断の研究に挑む。やがてビクターは1体の怪物を創り出すが、怪物は誕生直後に忽然と姿を消してしまう。それから3年後、再びビクターの前に現れた怪物は、ビクターへの呪いの言葉とともに復讐を誓い、彼の運命を大きく狂わせていく。 男性アイドルグループ「SUPER JUNIOR」のメンバーでミュージカル俳優としても活躍するキュヒョンがビクター・フランケンシュタイン役、卓越した歌唱力と表現力で韓国ミュージカル界を代表する俳優パク・ウンテがアンリ・デュプレ役でダブル主演を務めた。
n韓国ミュージカルonscreenフランケンシュタイン.synopsis_en: One installment of the cinema series Korean Musical ON SCREEN, which screens acclaimed Korean stage musicals in movie theaters. It screens the 2024 performance staged as the 10th-anniversary production of the Korean premiere of Frankenstein, the cornerstone of Korean original musicals by the golden team of director Wang Yong-beom and composer Brandon Lee. On the gruesome battlefields of the 19th-century Napoleonic Wars, scientist Victor Frankenstein undertakes the forbidden research of creating life. Victor eventually creates a monster, but the creature vanishes immediately after birth. Three years later, the monster reappears before Victor, swears revenge with words of curse against him, and throws his fate into turmoil. Kyuhyun, a member of the boy band SUPER JUNIOR and an active musical actor, plays Victor Frankenstein, and Park Eun-tae, a leading actor of the Korean musical world known for outstanding singing and expressiveness, co-stars as Henri Dupre.

n雷電.synopsis_en: Tokyo in 2021, under a state of emergency. Men tossed about by society, and a young man, Leo (Sakai Taisei), tossed about by those men. While great changes are occurring in society, what dominates Leo's daily life are romance, jealousy, self-love, and trivial conversations with friends. A friend gradually immerses himself in social movements, an activist who will use any means, a university professor who does not want change. He doesn't really understand politics. Still, he doesn't want to be thought of as indifferent—caught in between, Leo cannot decide where he stands. Though Leo harbors inner anxiety and conflict, he becomes talkative in front of his ex-lover (Hatta Asami), who still loves him; a female friend (Aida Tenma), who listens without interrupting; and Anna (Kaneyuki Rin), an unsuccessful actress he fell in love at first sight with. Adorning himself with words that lack substance, Leo barely keeps himself together. Eventually five years pass. What comes into view as Leo traces his memories is not the 2021 that has passed. It is our society, which continues even now, changing form. The film "Raiden" seeks to capture, through the comicality and precariousness of one young man, the atmosphere of an era that continues unbroken from 2021 to the present.

t506492.movie_title_jp: サンダーストーム 特殊捜査班
t506492.clean_title_jp: サンダーストーム 特殊捜査班
t506492.synopsis_en: The second of five films in the 'Storm' suspense action series starring Louis Koo of 'Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In' and 'Project BB,' depicting the struggle of an investigator confronting the corruption crimes rampant in Hong Kong society. Lok, an investigator at Hong Kong's Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC), witnesses a man he is tailing being shot dead while investigating people connected to the Hong Kong Jockey Club. As the ICAC and the police push forward with their investigations while clashing with each other, they arrive at the existence of illegal soccer gambling and an international match-fixing organization. Co-stars include Julian Cheung of 'The Prosecutor' and Vic Chou of the popular Taiwanese idol group F4. Director David Lam, who helmed the previous film, returns. It will be screened theatrically in November 2026 as part of 'Storm Complete History,' a special program screening all five 'Storm' series films.
t506492.tmdb_overview_en: ICAC Investigator William Luk and JFIU Chief Inspector Lau Po-keung both hit a dead end in their investigation of a bribery case and a money laundering case. In the meantime, William Luk was suspended when model Eva Ng went to Inspector Kenny Ching of ICAC’s Internal Investigation Group L, to file a report against him for accepting a $12M bribe.  Lau discovered Luk was set up and whoever framed Luk was connected to his case. He began to suspect the bank manager Thomson Yau was assisting a gangster, Wong Hoi-wo in money laundering activities. When Director Hong Liang of China’s Anti-Corruption & Bribery Bureau (ACBB) provided Lau with important intelligence, it became clear the money laundering activities were connected to a corrupted Vice-Ministerial Level cadre. To clear his name, William Luk put everything on the line…
t506492.tmdb_overview_jp: 廉政公署（ＩＣＡＣ）のルク捜査官(ルイス・クー）は贈収賄事件を、聯合財富情報組（ＪＦＩＵ）のラウ捜査官(ジュリアン・チョン）はマネーロンダリング事件を捜査するが、共に行き詰まりを迎える。時を同じくして、ＩＣＡＣの内部調査班Ｌ組にルクが賄賂を受け取ったという告発がなされ、ルクは停職処分を受ける。ラウはルクを陥れた人物が自らの事件に関与していると読み、銀行員のヤウに疑いの目を向ける。そこへ北京の汚職防止総局から重要な情報が提供され、マネーロンダリングに次官級の幹部が関与していると判明する。自らの潔白を証明するべく、ルクは全力で悪に立ち向かうが…

t378108.movie_title_en: In This Corner of the World
t378108.synopsis: 第13回文化庁メディア芸術祭マンガ部門優秀賞を受賞したこうの史代の同名コミックを、「マイマイ新子と千年の魔法」の片渕須直監督がアニメ映画化。第2次世界大戦下の広島・呉を舞台に、大切なものを失いながらも前向きに生きようとするヒロインと、彼女を取り巻く人々の日常を生き生きと描く。 昭和19年、故郷の広島市江波から20キロ離れた呉に18歳で嫁いできた女性すずは、戦争によって様々なものが欠乏する中で、家族の毎日の食卓を作るために工夫を凝らしていた。しかし戦争が進むにつれ、日本海軍の拠点である呉は空襲の標的となり、すずの身近なものも次々と失われていく。それでもなお、前を向いて日々の暮らしを営み続けるすずだったが……。 のんが主人公すず役でアニメ映画の声優に初挑戦。公開後は口コミやSNSで評判が広まり、15週連続で興行ランキングのトップ10入り。第90回キネマ旬報トップテンで「となりのトトロ」以来となるアニメーション作品での1位を獲得するなど高く評価され、第40回日本アカデミー賞でも最優秀アニメーション作品賞を受賞。国外でもフランスのアヌシー国際アニメーション映画祭の長編コンペティション部門で審査員賞を受賞した。 終戦80年を迎える2025年8月に再上映。
t378108.synopsis_en: Director Sunao Katabuchi (Mai Mai Miracle) adapts Fumiyo Kono's acclaimed manga of the same name—winner of the Excellence Award in the Manga Division at the 13th Japan Media Arts Festival—into an animated feature. Set in Hiroshima and Kure during World War II, the film vividly depicts the daily lives of a heroine who, despite losing the things most precious to her, keeps striving to live positively, along with the people around her. In 1944, 18-year-old Suzu marries into a family in Kure, 20 kilometers from her hometown of Eba in Hiroshima City. Amid the wartime scarcity of goods, she devises clever ways to put meals on her family's table each day. But as the war progresses, Kure—a key base of the Japanese Navy—becomes a target of air raids, and the things close to Suzu are lost one after another. Even so, Suzu keeps looking forward and carrying on with her everyday life, until... Non makes her voice-acting debut as the protagonist Suzu. After release, word of mouth and social media spread its reputation, and it stayed in the box-office top ten for 15 consecutive weeks. It was highly praised, becoming the first animated film to take first place in the 90th Kinema Junpo Top Ten since My Neighbor Totoro, and it also won Best Animated Feature at the 40th Japan Academy Awards. Overseas, it won the Jury Award in the feature competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in France. It will be re-released in August 2025, marking 80 years since the end of the war.
t378108.tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1943, during World War II. Young Suzu leaves her village near Hiroshima to marry and live with her in-laws in Kure, a military harbor. Her creativity to overcome deprivation quickly makes her indispensable at home. Inhabited by an ancestral wisdom, Suzu impregnates the simple gestures of everyday life with poetry and beauty. The many hardships, the loss of loved ones, the frequent air raids of the enemy, nothing alters her enthusiasm…
t378108.tmdb_overview_jp: 1944年広島。18歳のすずは、顔も見たことのない若者と結婚し、生まれ育った江波から20キロメートル離れた呉へとやって来る。それまで得意な絵を描いてばかりだった彼女は、一転して一家を支える主婦に。創意工夫を凝らしながら食糧難を乗り越え、毎日の食卓を作り出す。やがて戦争は激しくなり、日本海軍の要となっている呉はアメリカ軍によるすさまじい空襲にさらされ、数多くの軍艦が燃え上がり、町並みも破壊されていく。そんな状況でも懸命に生きていくすずだったが、ついに1945年8月を迎える。

nミスロンリネス.synopsis: 「OP PICTURES＋フェス2026」（26年11月27日～12月10日／東京・テアトル新宿）上映作品。
nミスロンリネス.synopsis_en: A screening in "OP PICTURES+ Festival 2026" (November 27 – December 10, 2026 / Theatre Shinjuku, Tokyo).

t1235304.director: セドリック・クラピッシュ
t1235304.synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
t1235304.synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.
t1235304.tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

t77285.synopsis: 名匠・成瀬巳喜男が林芙美子の同名小説を映画化し、日本映画を代表する1作として語り継がれる名作メロドラマ。戦後の荒廃した日本を舞台に、腐れ縁の男女の愛の顛末を描く。戦時下の昭和18年。タイピストとしてインドシナへ渡った幸田ゆき子は、技師の富岡兼吾と出会う。富岡には日本に残してきた妻がいたが、2人は恋に落ちる。終戦後、富岡はゆき子に妻との離婚を約束して日本へ戻る。しかし遅れて帰国したゆき子が東京の富岡の家を訪ねると、富岡はいまだに妻と暮らしていた。そんな富岡に失望したゆき子は別れを決意するが、結局離れることはできず、2人は不倫の関係をずるずると続けていく。ヒロイン・ゆき子を高峰秀子、相手役の富岡を森雅之がそれぞれ好演。
t77285.synopsis_en: Master director Mikio Naruse's adaptation of Fumiko Hayashi's novel of the same name, a celebrated melodrama long regarded as one of the finest works of Japanese cinema. Set in postwar, devastated Japan, it depicts the end of a love affair between a man and woman bound by a fateful, tangled relationship. In 1943, during the war, Yukiko Koda travels to Indochina as a typist and meets engineer Kanji Tomioka. Tomioka has a wife back in Japan, but the two fall in love. After the war ends, Tomioka promises Yukiko he will divorce his wife and returns to Japan. But when Yukiko returns later and visits Tomioka's home in Tokyo, he is still living with his wife. Disappointed in Tomioka, Yukiko resolves to leave him, but in the end she cannot, and the two drag on their affair. Hideko Takamine gives a fine performance as heroine Yukiko, with Masayuki Mori as her counterpart Tomioka.
t77285.tmdb_overview_en: A married Japanese forester during WWII is sent to Indochina to manage forests. He meets a young Japanese typist and promises to leave his wife. He doesn't and after the war, she turns up and the affair resumes.
t77285.tmdb_overview_jp: 戦時中の占領地・インドシナで愛人関係にあった幸田ゆき子と農林技師の富岡。引き揚げ後も妻ある謙吾との縁が切れず、ゆき子は自活のため身を売る。

t31104.synopsis_en: Yokosuka, Dobuita Street. A family that ran a brothel in a corner of the district lined with cabarets catering to sailors finds their business untenable due to crackdowns and begins raising pigs. Then one day, a former tout who has been asked by a senior figure to dispose of a corpse feeds that corpse to the pigs he has been caring for.
t31104.tmdb_overview_en: In the city of Yokosuka, Kinta and his lover Haruko, both involved with yakuza, brave the post-occupation period with a goal to be together.
t31104.tmdb_overview_jp: 横須賀、ドブ板通り。水兵相手のキャバレーが立ち並ぶ一角で売春ハウスを営んでいた一家は、取り締まりで商売が立ち行かなくなり、豚の飼育を始める。そんなある日、幹部から死体処理を頼まれた元客引きの男は、世話をしている豚にその死体を食わせてしまう

t427858.movie_title: 金融腐蝕列島 呪縛
t427858.movie_title_jp: 金融腐蝕列島 呪縛
t427858.synopsis_en: Following the revelation of large-scale profit provisions to sokaiya corporate extortionists, the Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office's Special Investigation Department launches an investigation into Asahi Chuo Bank. The management falls into a panic, doing nothing but watching the mood of their senior managing advisor Sasaki, who is also a heavyweight in political and business circles. Roused by the attitude of their superiors, the men known as the middle layer begin a battle for reconstruction in order to break the bank's corrupt traditions.
t427858.tmdb_overview_en: When a major bank is caught paying off a corporate extortionist, the media and prosecutors begin to dig, breaking open a money-and-favours scandal that threatens to rock the entire structure of business and government to its core. While the bank's top executives continue to vacillate, a quartet of middle-management reformers, led by straight-arrow Kitano (Koji Yakusho), decide to stage a boardroom coup and install a new, clean management team. With the aid of a hotshot news anchor (Mayumi Wakamura) and a hard-nosed prosecutor (Kenichi Endo), heads begin to roll.
t427858.tmdb_overview_jp: 総会屋への多額の利益供与が発覚し、朝日中央銀行に東京地検特捜部の捜査が入ることになった。経営陣はパニックに陥り、政財界の大物でもある佐々木取締相談役の顔色ばかり窺う有様だった。そんな上層部の態度に奮起したミドル層と呼ばれる男たちは、銀行の悪しき因習を断ち切るべく再建のための戦いを開始する。

n二世部隊.director: ロバート・ピロッシュ

t2346.synopsis: 06年のベネチア国際映画祭で金獅子賞に輝いた、中国の若き名匠ジャ・ジャンクー監督による人間ドラマ。ダム建設によって水没することが決まっている三峡の街。16年前に別れた妻子を探しにこの街を訪れた炭鉱夫サンミンは、かつて妻が住んでいた場所がすでに水没してしまったことを知る。一方、音信不通の夫を探しにやって来たシェン・ホンは、夫が働いていた工場を訪れるが、そこに彼の姿はなく……。
t2346.synopsis_en: Sanming (Han Sanming) comes from Shanxi Province to Fengjie, a city in the Yangtze River region, searching for his ex-wife (Ma Liqian) and daughter, whom he separated from 16 years ago. Relying on an old address, he visits his wife's family home, only to find it already submerged underwater due to dam construction. Inquiries at the government office lead nowhere, so he eventually settles into a cheap inn and decides to search for the two from there.
t2346.tmdb_overview_en: A town in Fengjie county is gradually being demolished and flooded to make way for the Three Gorges Dam. A man and woman visit the town to locate their estranged spouses, and become witness to the societal changes.
t2346.tmdb_overview_jp: サンミン（ハン・サンミン）は、16年前に別れた妻（マー・リーチェン）と娘を捜しに山西省から長江流域の都市、奉節にやって来る。昔の住所を頼りに妻の実家を訪ねたものの、そこはすでにダム建設のため水の底に沈んでいた。役所に問い合わせてもらちがあかず、結局、彼は安宿に腰を落ち着けて2人の行方を捜すことにする。

t1510327.movie_title_en: Catching the Stars of This Summer
t1510327.synopsis: 直木賞受賞作家・辻村深月の同名小説を映画化し、コロナ禍で複雑な思いを抱える中高生たちの青春を、東京都渋谷区、茨城県土浦市、長崎県五島市を舞台に描いたドラマ。 2020年。新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大により登校や部活動が制限されるなか、茨城県立砂浦高校の天文部に所属する2年生・溪本亜紗の提案で、リモート会議を活用し、各地で同時に天体観測をする競技「オンラインスターキャッチコンテスト」が実施されることになる。長崎の五島列島や東京都心の生徒たちも参加してスタートしたこの活動はやがて全国へと拡がり、ある奇跡を起こす。 「交換ウソ日記」の桜田ひよりが亜紗役で主演を務め、亜紗の同級生役で水沢林太郎、長崎の学生役で中野有紗、早瀬憩、東京の学生役で黒川想矢、星乃あんな、亜紗が所属する天文部の顧問役で岡部たかしが共演。2019年のショートフィルム「ワンナイトのあとに」や配信ドラマ「今日も浮つく、あなたは燃える」で話題を集めた山元環が長編商業映画初監督を務め、ドラマ「ケの日のケケケ」の森野マッシュが脚本を担当。「ルックバック」のharuka nakamuraが音楽を手がけた。
t1510327.synopsis_en: A drama based on the award-winning novel by Mizuki Tsujimura, depicting the complex emotions of junior high and high school students during the COVID-19 pandemic, set in Tokyo's Shibuya Ward, Tsuchiura City in Ibaraki Prefecture, and Goto City in Nagasaki Prefecture. In 2020, with school attendance and club activities restricted due to the pandemic, Aya Tanimoto, a second-year student in the astronomy club at Ibaraki Prefectural Sunaura High School, proposes an 'Online Star Catch Contest'—a competition using remote meetings to conduct simultaneous astronomical observations across different locations. The activity, joined by students from the Goto Islands in Nagasaki and central Tokyo, eventually spreads nationwide and sparks a miracle. Hiyori Sakurada, known for 'The Fake Diary,' stars as Aya. Rinataro Mizusawa plays her classmate; Arisa Nakano and Ikoi Hayase play students from Nagasaki; Soiya Kurokawa and Anna Hoshino play students from Tokyo; and Takashi Okabe plays the astronomy club advisor. Tamaki Yamamoto, who gained attention for the 2019 short film 'One Night After' and the streaming drama 'Today You're Restless, You're Burning,' makes his feature-length commercial film debut as director. Mash Morino, known for the drama 'Keke no Hi no Kekeke,' writes the screenplay. Haruka Nakamura, known for 'Look Back,' provides the music.
t1510327.tmdb_overview_en: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, when club activities were restricted, Japanese students launched an astronomical observation event called the "Star Catch Contest" via remote meetings. What began as a collaboration between students from Ibaraki, Tokyo, and Nagasaki's Goto Islands soon spread nationwide, leading to an unexpected miracle.

n粛清裁判.director: セルゲイ・ロズニツァ
n粛清裁判.synopsis: 国際的に高く評価されるウクライナ出身の鬼才セルゲイ・ロズニツァ監督が、スターリンによって行われた約90年前の裁判の記録映像を基に製作したドキュメンタリー。1930年モスクワで、8人の有識者が西側諸国と結託してクーデターを企てた疑いで裁判にかけられた。これはスターリンによる見せしめ裁判で、撮影された法廷の様子はソビエト最初期の発声映画「13日（「産業党」事件）」となった。発掘されたアーカイブフィルムには、無実の罪を着せられた被告人たちと、彼らを裁く権力側の大胆不敵な姿が記録されていた。スターリンの台頭に熱狂する群衆の映像を加えて再構成し、権力がいかにして人を欺き、群衆を扇動し、独裁政権を誕生させるかを描き出す。
n粛清裁判.synopsis_en: A documentary by internationally acclaimed Ukrainian-born maverick director Sergei Loznitsa, made from archival footage of a trial held about 90 years ago under Stalin. In 1930 in Moscow, eight intellectuals were put on trial on suspicion of conspiring with Western countries to plot a coup. This was a show trial staged by Stalin, and the filmed courtroom proceedings became one of the Soviet Union's earliest sound films, 'The 13th' (the 'Industrial Party' affair). The unearthed archival film recorded the defendants, falsely accused, and the bold, audacious demeanor of the authorities judging them. Reconstructed with added footage of crowds enthusiastic about Stalin's rise, the film depicts how power deceives people, incites the masses, and gives birth to a dictatorship.

n国葬.director: セルゲイ・ロズニツァ
n国葬.synopsis: 国際的に高く評価されるウクライナ出身の鬼才セルゲイ・ロズニツァ監督が、ソ連の独裁者スターリンの国葬を記録した貴重なアーカイブ映像を基に製作したドキュメンタリー。1953年3月5日、スターリンの死がソビエト全土に報じられた。その後リトアニアで、国葬の様子を捉えた大量のフィルムが発見される。200人弱のカメラマンによって撮影されたそのフィルムは幻の未公開映画「偉大なる別れ」のフッテージで、モスクワに安置されたスターリンの姿、周恩来ら各国共産党と東側諸国の指導者の弔問、後の権力闘争の中心となるフルシチョフら政府首脳のスピーチ、そしてヨーロッパからシベリアまで、国父の死を嘆き悲しむ数千万人の群衆の姿が鮮明に記録されていた。人類史上最大級の国葬の記録は、スターリンが生涯をかけて実現した社会主義国家の真の姿を明らかにする。
n国葬.synopsis_en: A documentary by internationally acclaimed Ukrainian-born maverick director Sergei Loznitsa, made from precious archival footage recording the state funeral of Soviet dictator Stalin. On March 5, 1953, Stalin's death was reported across the entire Soviet Union. Later, in Lithuania, a large quantity of film capturing the state funeral was discovered. Shot by nearly 200 cameramen, the footage belonged to the phantom unreleased film 'The Great Farewell,' and it vividly recorded Stalin lying in state in Moscow, the condolences of Zhou Enlai and other leaders of communist parties and Eastern Bloc countries, speeches by government leaders such as Khrushchev, who would later become central to the power struggle, and the tens of millions of people from Europe to Siberia mourning the death of the father of the nation. This record of one of the largest state funerals in human history reveals the true face of the socialist state that Stalin spent his life realizing.

nアウステルリッツ.director: セルゲイ・ロズニツァ
nアウステルリッツ.synopsis: ウクライナ出身の鬼才セルゲイ・ロズニツァ監督が、ホロコーストの現場となった元強制収容所を観光するダークツーリズムを題材に描いたドキュメンタリー。真夏のベルリン郊外。第2次世界大戦中に多くのユダヤ人が虐殺された元強制収容所の門に、群衆が吸い寄せられていく。辺り構わずスマートフォンで記念撮影をする人々、誰かの消し忘れた携帯からはベートーベンの「運命」の着信音が鳴り響く。戦後75年を経た現在、記憶を社会で共有し未来へつなげる試みはツーリズムと化していた。ドイツ人作家W・G・ゼーバルトの同名小説に着想を得て製作。
nアウステルリッツ.synopsis_en: A documentary by Ukrainian-born maverick director Sergei Loznitsa on the subject of dark tourism—tourists visiting former concentration camps that were sites of the Holocaust. In midsummer on the outskirts of Berlin, crowds are drawn to the gate of a former concentration camp where many Jews were massacred during World War II. People take commemorative photos with their smartphones without a care, and from someone's forgotten mobile phone rings Beethoven's 'Fate' (Symphony No. 5) ringtone. Now, 75 years after the war, the attempt to share memory in society and connect it to the future has turned into tourism. The film was inspired by the novel of the same name by German writer W. G. Sebald.

n地獄から来た花嫁地獄新娘.movie_title: 地獄から来た花嫁（地獄新娘）
n地獄から来た花嫁地獄新娘.movie_title_jp: 地獄から来た花嫁（地獄新娘）

t8672.movie_title: キンスキー、我が最愛の敵
t8672.movie_title_jp: キンスキー、我が最愛の敵
t8672.clean_title_jp: キンスキー、我が最愛の敵
t8672.director: ベルナー・ヘルツォーク
t8672.tmdb_overview_en: A film that describes the love-hate relationship between Werner Herzog and Klaus Kinski, the deep trust between the director and the actor, and their independently and simultaneously hatched plans to murder one another.

t1508322.synopsis_en: A humorous drama about the inheritance disputes that erupt within a once-close family after the death of their elderly mother. The Suzuki family mourns the loss of their mother, but soon, arguments break out over her estate: the eldest and second daughters insist on selling the family home and splitting the proceeds, the younger brother and his wife claim the land and house as their inheritance as the family successor, and the widow of the deceased eldest son joins the fray, souring their previously warm relationships. When a later-discovered will surfaces, objections arise, worsening the rifts. The conflict escalates to the point of litigation, but... Nene Otsuka plays the eldest daughter Reiko, Yami Yumiko plays the second daughter Satomi, and Shinobu Nakayama plays Sanae, the widow of the late eldest son. Akiko Matsumoto takes on the role of a consultant offering inheritance advice from a legal standpoint, while Yota Kawase plays Reiko's husband Seiichi. The film is directed and written by Fujimura Mamiya, known for scripting the 'Care Nin' series, which depicted the realities of nursing care.
t1508322.tmdb_overview_en: The Suzuki family faced the problem of inheritence division when their mother died. Different views on rights, obligations and affection for the mother have divided key family members. Will mother's love, filial piety and family ties heal the separation between them?

n西安健監督短編特集3本立て.movie_title: 西安健監督短編特集3本立て
n西安健監督短編特集3本立て.movie_title_jp: 西安健監督短編特集3本立て

t952438.synopsis: 魚類に関する豊富な知識でタレントや学者としても活躍するさかなクンの半生を、沖田修一監督がのんを主演に迎えて映画化。「横道世之介」でも組んだ沖田監督と前田司郎がともに脚本を手がけ、さかなクンの自叙伝「さかなクンの一魚一会　まいにち夢中な人生！」をもとに、フィクションを織り交ぜながらユーモアたっぷりに描く。 小学生のミー坊は魚が大好きで、寝ても覚めても魚のことばかり考えている。父親は周囲の子どもとは少し違うことを心配するが、母親はそんなミー坊を温かく見守り、背中を押し続けた。高校生になっても魚に夢中なミー坊は、町の不良たちとも何故か仲が良い。やがてひとり暮らしを始めたミー坊は、多くの出会いや再会を経験しながら、ミー坊だけが進むことのできる道へ飛び込んでいく。 幼なじみの不良ヒヨを柳楽優弥、ひょんなことからミー坊と一緒に暮らすシングルマザーのモモコを夏帆、ある出来事からミー坊との絆を深める不良の総長を磯村勇斗が演じる。原作者のさかなクンも出演。
t952438.synopsis_en: Director Shuichi Okita adapts the life of Sakana-kun, a TV personality and scholar known for his extensive knowledge of fish, into a film starring Non. Okita, who previously collaborated with screenwriter Shiro Maeda on "A Story of Yonosuke," co-wrote the script with Maeda, drawing from Sakana-kun's autobiography "Sakana-kun's One Fish, One Encounter: A Life Absorbed in Passion!" and weaving in fictional elements for a humor-filled portrayal. Elementary schooler Mi-bo loves fish and thinks about them morning, noon, and night. His father worries that he's a bit different from other children, but his mother warmly watches over him and keeps encouraging him. Even in high school, Mi-bo remains obsessed with fish and somehow gets along well with the town's delinquents. Eventually living on his own, Mi-bo experiences many encounters and reunions as he dives into a path only he can walk. Yuya Yagira plays his childhood friend Hiyo, a delinquent; Kaho plays Momoko, a single mother who ends up living with Mi-bo; and Hayato Isomura plays the gang leader who deepens his bond with Mi-bo after a certain incident. Original author Sakana-kun also appears.
t952438.tmdb_overview_en: A young child is obsessed with learning about and drawing fish. The child seems a little odd, but if you are understanding and supportive you will be cheering in the end.
t952438.tmdb_overview_jp: 毎日魚を見つめ、その絵を描き、食べ続けても飽きないほど魚が大好きな小学生の“ミー坊”。わが子が少々変わっていることを父親が心配する一方で、母親は彼を温かく見守り応援している。高校生になっても相変わらず魚に夢中なミー坊は、町の不良とも仲が良く、いつの間にか周囲の人々の中心にいるのだった。やがて、一人暮らしを始めたミー坊(のん)はさまざまな出会いを経験し、自分だけが進むことのできるただ一つの道を突き進んでいく。

nするとかしないとか.synopsis: 「OP PICTURES＋フェス2026」（26年11月27日～12月10日／東京・テアトル新宿）上映作品。
nするとかしないとか.synopsis_en: A screening in "OP PICTURES+ Festival 2026" (November 27 – December 10, 2026 / Theatre Shinjuku, Tokyo).

t1479360.tmdb_overview_en: This is a film adaptation of a popular NHK drama that depicts a strong-willed woman, Hana, who lives a lively life while being swept up in the waves of the Meiji, Taisho, and Showa eras.

nでっかいでっかい野郎.movie_title: でっかいでっかい野郎
nでっかいでっかい野郎.movie_title_jp: でっかいでっかい野郎

nなにがなんでも為五郎.movie_title_jp: なにがなんでも為五郎

t1310165.synopsis: 日本で女優として長篇劇映画のプロダクションを初めて興した入江たか子の主演作で、入江ぷろと木村の協働が生んだ重要作。寒村から南方に出稼ぎにいった多くの女性のひとり、おゆき（入江）は、西欧人との間に生まれた子どもをつれて故郷に帰る。しかし、村の男たちは彼女を差別し、お金を搾取することしか考えていなかった。2人の苦難と、同じ境遇の女性たちとの連帯が、アイデアに満ちた鮮烈な演出で描かれる。
t1310165.synopsis_en: A starring vehicle for Takako Irie, who became the first woman in Japan to establish a production company for feature-length narrative films, this is an important work born from the collaboration between Irie Productions and Kimura. Oyuki (Irie), one of many women who left her impoverished village to work in the South Seas, returns home with a child born from a relationship with a Western man. However, the village men discriminate against her and think only of exploiting her money. The hardships of the two and their solidarity with women in the same situation are depicted through vivid, idea-rich direction.
t1310165.tmdb_overview_en: "Karayuki-san offers a no-holds-barred depiction of the discrimination faced by a former prostitute who returns to Japan from Singapore with her mixed-race son." - Alexander Jacoby (Oxford Brookes University)

n牧塲物語.synopsis: 中国戦線で軍医から故郷の牧場を託された3人は、閉鎖を企む高利貸しから牧場を守ろうと従業員一同と奮闘する。国家総動員法成立と同年の公開で、銃後の意識の啓発を企図して製作された。生産の場を働く者たちの共同体として捉え、資本の脅威に対抗するさまが、社会主義的とも評された『麦秋』（キング・ヴィダー、1934）も彷彿とさせ興味深い。本作でデビューの江波和子は、高利貸しの社長令嬢であるヒロインを演じている。
n牧塲物語.synopsis_en: Three men entrusted with their hometown ranch by an army doctor on the China front struggle alongside all the employees to protect the ranch from a moneylender plotting to shut it down. Released in the same year the National Mobilization Law was enacted, it was produced with the intent of raising home-front awareness. It is fascinating how the production site is conceived as a community of workers resisting the threat of capital, evoking King Vidor's Our Daily Bread (1934), which was also described as socialist. Kazuko Enami, making her debut in this film, plays the heroine, the daughter of the moneylender company's president.

t104452.synopsis_en: Masao, the eldest son of the Hino family, spends his days possessed by Buddhist statues, contrary to his parents' wishes. One day, while the family is away, he has a sexual relationship with his beautiful older sister Yuri, and Yuri becomes pregnant. Masao arranges for his sister to marry the student boarder Iwashita, while he himself becomes an apprentice to a Buddhist sculptor in Kyoto, but...
t104452.tmdb_overview_en: Near a remote Buddhist monastery, a young man falls in love with his sister and gets her pregnant. After a monk finds out, the young man becomes an assistant to a master sculptor, only to proceed to complicate matters with his affairs.
t104452.tmdb_overview_jp: 日野家の長男、正夫は親の希望に反して仏像に取り憑かれている毎日を送っていた。ある日、家族の留守中に美しい姉の百合と肉体関係を持ち、百合は妊娠した。正夫は姉を書生の岩下と結婚させ、自らは京都の仏師に弟子入りするのだったが…。

nプラットホーム.synopsis: 80年代半ばの中国山西省、ミンリャンら幼なじみの4人は小さな町の劇団員。彼らは地方巡業の旅に出るが、やがて政府の方針の変化による自由化の波が押し寄せ、4人の関係は不安定になっていく。地方劇団の10年間を通して、激動の80年代中国を描く話題作。監督は中国の新世代、ジャ・ジャンクー。デビュー作「一瞬の夢」(98)でベルリン映画祭新人監督賞を受賞、本作は00年ベネチア映画祭最優秀アジア映画賞に。
nプラットホーム.synopsis_en: In the mid-1980s in Shanxi Province, China, Minliang and three childhood friends are members of a small-town theater troupe. They set out on a tour of provincial performances, but before long the wave of liberalization brought on by changes in government policy sweeps in, and the relationships among the four grow unstable. Through ten years in the life of a provincial theater troupe, this much-talked-about work depicts China during the tumultuous 1980s. The director is Jia Zhangke, a new generation of Chinese cinema. His debut feature 'Xiao Wu' (98) won the New Director award at the Berlin Film Festival, and this film won the Best Asian Film award at the 2000 Venice Film Festival.

t80243.synopsis: 前作「プラットホーム」で80年代の中国の若者たちをビビッドに描いて高い評価を得たジャ・ジャンクー監督が、再び中国の地方都市を舞台に、現代の若者たちの不安や焦燥を等身大で見せる青春ドラマ。2001年の中国山西省・大同（ダートン）。経済的、国際的にも急成長を遂げた現代中国の地方都市で、期待と恐れ、社会への矛盾とを抱え苦悩する2組の若者が、未来に立ちはだかる大きな壁に立ち向かう姿を描く。「好きなように生きる」という歌詞が受け、大ヒットした台湾の曲「任逍遥」が劇中印象的に使われる。第55回カンヌ国際映画祭正式招待作品。
t80243.synopsis_en: Director Jia Zhangke, who won high acclaim for vividly portraying Chinese youth of the 1980s in his previous film 'Platform,' returns to a Chinese provincial city to present a youth drama that captures the anxieties and frustrations of contemporary young people at eye level. Datong, Shanxi Province, China, 2001. In a provincial city of modern China that has achieved rapid economic and international growth, two pairs of young people, burdened by hope and fear and by contradictions toward society, confront the great walls standing in the way of their future. The Taiwanese song 'Ren Xiaoyao,' whose lyrics 'live however you like' struck a chord and became a huge hit, is used memorably in the film. An official selection of the 55th Cannes International Film Festival.
t80243.tmdb_overview_en: Two disaffected, unemployed Chinese youth drift through life on the streets of their industrial town, their paths crossing with that of a local young singer and dancer working for a liquor company as a spokesmodel.

nblueheronブルーヘロン.director: ソフィー・ロムヴァリ
nblueheronブルーヘロン.synopsis:
世界各地で絶賛と共感！
新鋭ソフィー・ロムヴァリが描く、ある家族を巡る
今年もっとも胸を締めつける物語
nblueheronブルーヘロン.synopsis_en: In the summer of the late 1990s, eight-year-old Sasha moves to Vancouver Island, Canada, with her family of Hungarian immigrants. Surrounded by rich nature, Sasha gradually finds her place while spending time with her older brothers and new friends. However, her eldest brother Jeremy repeatedly engages in 'problem behavior,' and the family is reaching its limit. As the parents consult experts about Jeremy's problems, they are forced to make a difficult choice. Twenty years later, Sasha, now a film director, begins tracing her family's past with a camera in hand—

t1688981.director: イルディコー・エニェディ
t1688981.synopsis: もし、植物も私たちを見ていたら──？
t1688981.synopsis_en: What if the plants are watching us, too—?
t1688981.tmdb_overview_en: Mike is a married man whose life changes after a hidden affair leaves him HIV positive. Struggling with guilt, fear, and the impact on his marriage, he begins attending a support group. There he meets Wes, a gay man dealing with his own experiences and stigma around HIV. Through their conversations and growing friendship, the two men confront shame, secrecy, and the emotional fallout of the diagnosis. Their connection becomes a space for honesty and reflection as Mike re-examines his relationships, identity, and responsibility toward the people in his life.

t1654276.synopsis: 安田章大（SUPER EIGHT）とのんが主演を務め、自閉スペクトラム症の兄と結婚を控える妹の温かくも強い絆を描いたヒューマンドラマ。 自閉スペクトラム症の大貴と、幼い頃から彼を支えてきた妹の希。母を早くに亡くした彼らはネグレクト気味の父から距離を置き、ふたりで懸命に生きてきた。現在、大貴は清掃の仕事に就き、周囲のサポートを受けながら自立した生活を送っている。大貴はほとんど会話をせず、表情もあまり変わらないように見える。独自の規則を持つ彼は、すべてを平行と垂直に並べるほど几帳面でこだわりが強く、机に並ぶ食器もていねいにそろえる。週に1度の希との食事の時間は19時ちょうどで、1分でも過ぎると落ち着かなくなる。カウンセラーとして働いている希は、ある日恋人からプロポーズを受け、一抹の不安を抱えながら大貴とともに恋人の両親に会いに大阪から東京へ向かう。希の結婚話をきっかけに、兄妹は思いがけずお互いの過去と未来に向き合うことになる。 劇団ふくふくや主宰で俳優としても活躍する山野海によるオリジナル脚本に感銘を受けた安田章大が製作を熱望し、企画から参加。自閉スペクトラム症の専門家の監修のもと約2年かけて脚本を練り、安田自身も専門家のレクチャーを受けて撮影に臨んだ。監督は「かぞくのひけつ」「毎日かあさん」の小林聖太郎。
t1654276.synopsis_en: Yasuda Shota (SUPER EIGHT) and Non star in this human drama depicting the warm yet strong bond between a brother with autism spectrum disorder and his sister who is about to get married. Taiki, who has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi, who has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother early, they kept their distance from their neglectful father and lived desperately on their own. Now, Taiki works a cleaning job and lives independently with support from those around him. Taiki rarely speaks and his expressions seem to barely change. He has his own rules and is so meticulous and particular that he arranges everything in parallel and perpendicular lines, carefully lining up the dishes on the table. His weekly meal with Nozomi is exactly at 7:00 PM, and he becomes restless if it's even a minute past. Nozomi, who works as a counselor, one day receives a proposal from her boyfriend, and with a hint of unease, heads to Tokyo with Taiki to meet her boyfriend's parents. Triggered by Nozomi's marriage talk, the siblings unexpectedly come face to face with each other's past and future. Yasuda Shota, deeply impressed by the original screenplay by Yamano Umi—who leads the theater company Fuku Fukuya and is also active as an actress—fervently wished to produce it and participated from the planning stage. The script was developed over about two years under the supervision of an autism spectrum disorder specialist, and Yasuda himself received lectures from the specialist before filming. Directed by Kobayashi Seitaro of "Kazoku no Hiketsu" and "Mainichi Kaasan."
t1654276.tmdb_overview_en: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together
t1654276.tmdb_overview_jp: 自閉症の大貴と定型発達の希、そんな兄妹の微々たる成長物語であその2人と関わる人々が心に棲まわせる寛大、辛辣、はたまた無関心というあらゆる本音たちと共に生きていく物語です。

t1621964.synopsis: ベストセラー作家・東野圭吾が、罪と罰というテーマを重厚な物語で描いた同名ミステリー小説を、実写映画「秒速5センチメートル」の松村北斗（SixTONES）とNHK連続テレビ小説「あんぱん」の今田美桜が主演を務めて映画化。解決したはずの殺人事件の容疑者の息子と被害者の娘が手を組み、事件の真相を追う姿を描き出す。 善良な弁護士・白石健介が刺殺された事件は、容疑者として浮上した倉木達郎が犯行を自供したことにより解決したはずだった。しかし、容疑者の息子である倉木和真と被害者の娘の白石美令は、互いの父親の言動に違和感を抱く。出会ってはならないはずの2人は手を取り合い、共に事件の真相を追いはじめる。 容疑者の息子・倉木和真を松村、被害者の娘・白石美令を今田が演じ、容疑者・倉木達郎役で三浦友和、被害者・白石健介役で中村芝翫、事件を捜査する警視庁捜査一課の刑事・五代努役で柄本佑、五代と共に行動する所轄の刑事・中町役で前原愰、倉木達郎についてよく知る小料理屋の店主・浅羽洋子役で風吹ジュン、洋子の娘・織恵役で井川遥、白石健介の妻で美令の母・綾子役で吉田羊が共演。「正欲」「あゝ、荒野」の岸善幸監督がメガホンをとり、「愚か者の身分」「ある男」の向井康介が脚本を担当。
t1621964.synopsis_en: Best-selling author Higashino Keigo's weighty mystery novel exploring the themes of crime and punishment is adapted for film, starring Matsumura Hokuto (SixTONES) of the live-action '5 Centimeters per Second' and Imada Mio of the NHK morning drama 'Anpan.' It depicts the son of a suspect in a supposedly solved murder case and the daughter of the victim joining forces to pursue the truth. The case of the murder of the good-hearted lawyer Shiraishi Kensuke by stabbing was supposed to have been resolved when Kuraki Tatsuro, who emerged as a suspect, confessed. However, Kuraki Kazuma, the suspect's son, and Shiraishi Mirei, the victim's daughter, both feel something is off about their fathers' words and actions. The two, who should never have met, join hands and begin pursuing the truth together. Matsumura plays Kuraki Kazuma, the suspect's son; Imada plays Shiraishi Mirei, the victim's daughter. Miura Tomokazu plays the suspect Kuraki Tatsuro, Nakamura Shikan plays the victim Shiraishi Kensuke, Emoto Tasuku plays Godai Tsutomu, a detective from the Metropolitan Police Department's First Investigative Division, Maehara Ko plays Nakamachi, a local detective working with Godai, Fubuki Jun plays Asaba Yoko, the owner of a small restaurant who knows Kuraki Tatsuro well, Ikawa Haru plays Yorue, Yoko's daughter, and Yoshida Yo plays Ayako, Shiraishi Kensuke's wife and Mirei's mother. Directed by Kishi Nobuyuki ('Positive,' 'Ah, Wilderness'), with a screenplay by Mukai Kosuke ('The Role of a Fool,' 'A Man').
t1621964.tmdb_overview_en: A kind-hearted lawyer is found stabbed to death. One man emerges as the prime suspect. With his confession the case should have been solved. But the suspect's son, Kuraki Kazuma and the victim's daughter, Shiraishi Mirei, both sense that something about their fathers' words and actions doesn't add up. When the suspect's son and the victim's daughter join forces, the very notion of the truth begins to unravel.

t1600745.movie_title_en: The Whole Floor Is Like This
t1600745.synopsis: 仲良しだけど共同生活に少しずつ不満を抱える2人の女性が、汚い部屋を片付けようと奮闘する一夜を描いたドラマ。 好奇心旺盛でトイレが長い矢吹ことりと、発酵食品マニアで家事が苦手な三森すずか。ベストフレンドの2人はシェアハウスをしているが、どこか違和感を覚えていた。そんなある日、2人の家に憧れの男性・栗田さんが遊びに来ることになるが、信じられないほど部屋が汚い。タイムリミットの朝10時までにどうにかするべく、一緒に大掃除に取りかかることりとすずかだったが……。 「スミコ22」「まだ君を知らない」で知られる、はまださつきと福岡佐和子による映像制作ユニット「しどろもどり」が、自身のシェアハウス経験をもとに制作。はまだが監督を務め、福岡が脚本・編集を手がけた。「結局珈琲」の瀬戸璃子が矢吹ことり役、「おとなになりたくなれますように」の園凛が三森すずか役で主演を務め、松㟢翔平、新帆ゆき、特別出演として工藤遥が脇を固める。シンガーソングライター・かなふぁんによるプロジェクト「chill the gambler」「kiss the gambler」が音楽と主題歌を担当。
t1600745.synopsis_en: A drama about two women who are close friends but growing increasingly dissatisfied with their shared living situation, as they struggle to clean their filthy apartment over the course of one night. Yabuki Kotori is curious and takes long trips to the toilet, while Mimori Suzuka is a fermented food enthusiast who is bad at housework. The best friends share a house, but something feels off. One day, their dream man, Kurita-san, is coming to visit, but their apartment is unbelievably dirty. With a deadline of 10 a.m., Kotori and Suzuka start a big cleanup together, but... Created by the filmmaking unit "Shidoromodori," known for "Sumiko 22" and "I Still Don't Know You," consisting of Hamada Satsuki and Fukuoka Sawako, based on their own shared-house experiences. Hamada directs, and Fukuoka handles the script and editing. Seto Riko (from "Kekkyoku Kohi") stars as Yabuki Kotori, and Sono Rin (from "Otona ni Naritakunaremasu you ni") stars as Mimori Suzuka, with Matsuzaki Shohei, Shinpo Yuki, and Kudo Haruka in a special appearance supporting the cast. The project "chill the gambler" and "kiss the gambler" by singer-songwriter Kana-fan provides the music and theme song.
t1600745.tmdb_overview_jp: ことりとすずかは、お互いの怠惰な姿勢や干渉具合を原因にシェアハウス解消の危機を感じている。そんな中、近所のカフェの店主である栗田が家に遊びに来ることに。栗田に仄かな恋心を抱いている二人は浮き足立ち、汚い部屋を掃除しはじめる。

t178236.movie_title_jp: 男はつらいよ 寅次郎忘れな草

t178236.movie_title_original: 男はつらいよ 寅次郎忘れな草
t178236.synopsis_en: The 11th installment in the "Otoko wa Tsurai yo" series. Torajiro, who has traveled to Abashiri in Hokkaido in early summer, meets Lily Matsuoka (Kiyoko Matsuoka), a third-rate traveling singer. Lily is a manly woman who curses at everything, and Torajiro is initially at a loss with her. But once he realizes it is all a bluff, Torajiro feels sympathy for her because his own circumstances closely resemble the environment in which Lily grew up. As Lily listens to Torajiro's story of his wounded heart, she comes to look up to him like an older brother. However, Torajiro's sympathy eventually turns into an overwhelming romantic love.
t178236.tmdb_overview_en: On the road again, Torajiro meets a kindred spirit in Lily, a lounge singer.
t178236.tmdb_overview_jp: 「男はつらいよ」シリーズ第11作。 初夏の北海道網走に出向いていた寅次郎は、そこでドサ回りの三流歌手リリー松岡（松岡清子）と出会う。何かにつけて悪態をつく男勝りのリリーに寅次郎も最初のうちは手を焼いた。が、やがてそれが虚勢だと気づいた寅次郎は、自分の身の上とリリーの育った環境が良く似ていることから同情心を抱く。リリーも心に傷を負った寅次郎の話を聞くうちに、寅次郎を兄のように慕うようになった。しかし、寅次郎の同情心はやがて抑えがたいほどの恋心へと変化していくのであった。

t52980.movie_title: 仁義なき戦い 広島死闘篇
t52980.movie_title_jp: 仁義なき戦い 広島死闘篇
t52980.movie_title_en: Battles Without Honor and Humanity: Deadly Fight in Hiroshima
t52980.clean_title_jp: 仁義なき戦い 広島死闘篇
t52980.movie_title_original: 仁義なき戦い 広島死闘篇
t52980.synopsis_en: 1950 (Showa 25), Hiroshima City. Masaharu Yamanaka, a demobilized soldier who was beaten by the Otomo gang's Katsutoshi Otomo for dining and dashing, is tenderly nursed back to health by Yasuko Uehara, the widow and niece of Muraoka gang boss Tsuneo Muraoka. Through this connection, Yamanaka becomes a member of the Muraoka gang, but a chance encounter leads to a sexual relationship with Yasuko, which incurs the wrath of Boss Muraoka, and Yamanaka flees to Kyushu on the orders of wakagashira Matsunaga. However, the shooting death of Wada gang boss in Kyushu makes Yamanaka's name resound throughout the underworld, and he is permitted to return to Hiroshima, with his relationship with Yasuko also approved by Boss Muraoka.
t52980.tmdb_overview_en: Repeatedly beat to a pulp by gamblers, cops, and gangsters, lone wolf Shoji Yamanaka finally finds a home as a Muraoka family hitman and falls in love with boss Muraoka's niece. Meanwhile, the ambitions of mad dog Katsutoshi Otomo draws our series' hero, Shozo Hirono, and the other yakuza into a new round of bloodshed.
t52980.tmdb_overview_jp: 1950年（昭和25年）、広島市。無銭飲食により博徒大友組・大友勝利のリンチを受けた復員兵・山中正治は、村岡組組長・村岡常夫の姪で未亡人である上原靖子によって手厚く看病される。その縁で山中は村岡組組員となるが、ふとした事から靖子と男女の関係となり、それが村岡組長の逆鱗に触れ山中は若頭・松永の指示で九州へ逃れる。しかし九州での和田組組長射殺事件により山中の名は裏社会で大きく轟くこととなり、山中は広島への帰参を許され、靖子との交際も村岡組長の認める所となった。

t41292.synopsis: 「プラットホーム」「青い稲妻」で世界的に注目を集める中国監督ジャ・ジャンクーの最新作。北京郊外にあるアミューズメント・パーク“世界公園”は、パリのエッフェル塔やイタリアのピサの斜塔など世界の名所を縮小して再現したテーマパーク。そこで働くダンサー、タオの毎日の不安と希望を、08年のオリンピック開催に向け変貌していく北京の街を背景に細やかに描く。タオ役はジャ・ジャンクー作品の常連、チャオ・タオ。
t41292.synopsis_en: The latest film from Chinese director Jia Zhangke, who drew worldwide attention with Platform and The Blue Kite. World Park, an amusement park on the outskirts of Beijing, is a theme park that reproduces famous landmarks from around the world in miniature, including the Eiffel Tower of Paris and the Leaning Tower of Pisa of Italy. The film delicately depicts the daily anxieties and hopes of Tao, a dancer who works there, against the backdrop of Beijing as the city transforms ahead of the 2008 Olympics. Tao is played by Zhao Tao, a regular in Jia Zhangke's films.
t41292.tmdb_overview_en: At Beijing World Park, a bizarre cross-pollination of Las Vegas and Epcot Center where visitors can interact with famous international monuments without ever leaving the city’s suburbs, a security guard betrays his dancer girlfriend by pursuing another woman.

t238.director: フランシス・フォード・コッポラ
t238.synopsis: アメリカのマフィアの内幕を描いたマリオ・プーゾのベストセラー小説を、当時32歳のフランシス・フォード・コッポラ監督が映画化した壮大なファミリードラマ。イタリア・シシリー島からアメリカに移住し、巨万の富を築き上げたビトー・コルレオーネ一族の跡目相続や、世代交代を謀る周囲のマフィアとの間に起こる抗争が重厚なタッチで綴られる。主演はマーロン・ブランドとアル・パチーノ。72年度のアカデミー賞では作品賞を含む3部門を受賞した。日本でも1972年に劇場公開。2004年6月にデジタルリマスター版でリバイバル上映されている。
t238.synopsis_en: Don Corleone emigrated from Sicily to America and built a fortune in a single generation. His third son, Michael, wanted only to live an honest life, but when the Don is attacked and gravely wounded by a rival family, he resolves to take revenge. And New York becomes a battleground for the feud...
t238.tmdb_overview_en: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
t238.tmdb_overview_jp: シシリーからアメリカに移住し、一代で財を成したドン・コルレオーネ。三男のマイケルはひとり堅気な人生を送ろうとしていたが、敵対するファミリーにドンが襲われ重傷を負った時、彼は報復を決意する。そしてニューヨークは抗争の場と化していった……。

t240.clean_title_jp: ゴッドファーザー PART II
t240.director: フランシス・フォード・コッポラ
t240.synopsis: フランシス・フォード・コッポラ監督の代表作「ゴッドファーザー」のシリーズ第2作。前作でコルレオーネ・ファミリーの首領となったマイケルの苦悩の日々と、彼の父ビトーの若き日を交錯させながら描く。1958年。亡き父ビトーの後を継いでファミリーのボスの座に就いたマイケルは、収入源であるラスベガスに近いネバダ州タホー湖畔に根拠地を移す。そんな彼は、ことあるごとに偉大な父を思い出していた。1901年、シチリア島。9歳のビトーはマフィアに両親と兄を殺されて天涯孤独となり、単身ニューヨークへと渡る。リトルイタリーで成長した彼は、街を牛耳るギャングを暗殺したことをきっかけに移民たちの信頼を集め、頭角を現していく。第47回アカデミー賞で作品賞など6部門を受賞。若き日のビトーを演じたロバート・デ・ニーロは同助演男優賞に輝いた。
t240.synopsis_en: The second installment in director Francis Ford Coppola's landmark Godfather series. The film interweaves the anguish-filled days of Michael, who became head of the Corleone family in the previous film, with the younger days of his father Vito. It is 1958. Michael, having succeeded his late father Vito as the family's boss, relocates the base of operations to the Lake Tahoe area of Nevada, near Las Vegas, the family's source of income. At every turn, he finds himself recalling his great father. In 1901, on the island of Sicily, nine-year-old Vito loses both his parents and his older brother to the Mafia, leaving him utterly alone, and he crosses to New York by himself. Growing up in Little Italy, he earns the trust of immigrants after assassinating the gangster who ruled the streets, and begins to rise to prominence. The film won six Academy Awards at the 47th ceremony, including Best Picture. Robert De Niro, who played the young Vito, took home the Best Supporting Actor award.
t240.tmdb_overview_en: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
t240.tmdb_overview_jp: 亡き父のあとを継ぎドンとなったマイケルの苦悩と復讐を、父ビトーの少年時代からやがて一大ファミリーを築くまでのエピソードを交えて描いた、名作「ゴッドファーザー」の第2作。幼いビトーが青年となり、やがてファミリーを築くまでの物語と、父のあとを継ぎドンとなったマイケルの、父がそうであった頃と全く変わってしまった時代の中でのドンとしての苦悩と復讐の物語を、巧みに交差しながら展開していく。

nゴッドファーザー最終章マイケルコルレオーネの最期.movie_title: ゴッドファーザー　最終章　マイケル・コルレオーネの最期
nゴッドファーザー最終章マイケルコルレオーネの最期.movie_title_jp: ゴッドファーザー　最終章　マイケル・コルレオーネの最期
nゴッドファーザー最終章マイケルコルレオーネの最期.director: フランシス・フォード・コッポラ
nゴッドファーザー最終章マイケルコルレオーネの最期.synopsis: フランシス・フォード・コッポラ監督による傑作「ゴッドファーザー」3部作の完結編「ゴッドファーザーPARTIII」。その全米公開30周年を記念して製作された新バージョン。コッポラ監督自身の手により再編集を施し、オリジナルネガからの4Kスキャンやデジタルレストア、新たなオープニング、エンディングシーン、音楽の追加などが行われた。1979年、老境に入ったマイケルは、自分の犯してきた罪に苦悩していた。そんな彼は、資産を合法化するためバチカン銀行と大司教に接近し、寄付の見返りに叙勲を受け、その祝いの席で家族と再会。そこには、いまは亡き長兄ソニーの息子ビンセントの姿もあった。かつてのコルレオーネ家の縄張りはジョーイ・ザザによって牛耳られており、ビンセントもザザの配下にいた。そんなビンセントを呼び戻し、後継者として合法的なビジネスをさせようとしたマイケルだったが、そのことからザザとビンセントの間に争いが起こり……。
nゴッドファーザー最終章マイケルコルレオーネの最期.synopsis_en: A new version produced to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the U.S. release of The Godfather Part III, the concluding chapter of Francis Ford Coppola's masterpiece Godfather trilogy. Re-edited by Coppola himself, it features a 4K scan from the original negative, digital restoration, a new opening, an ending scene, and added music. In 1979, Michael, now in his old age, is tormented by the sins he has committed. To legitimize his assets, he approaches the Vatican Bank and the Archbishop, receives an honor in return for a donation, and at the celebration reunites with his family. There, too, is Vincent, the son of his late eldest brother Sonny. The Corleone family's former territory is now controlled by Joey Zasa, and Vincent was among Zasa's men. Michael calls Vincent back and tries to have him run legitimate business as his successor, but this sparks a conflict between Zasa and Vincent...

nモーレツ花嫁気弱な婿さん三八新娘憨子婿.movie_title: モーレツ花嫁 気弱な婿さん（三八新娘憨子婿）
nモーレツ花嫁気弱な婿さん三八新娘憨子婿.movie_title_jp: モーレツ花嫁 気弱な婿さん（三八新娘憨子婿）

n長崎の子うなぎとり.synopsis: 爆心地に近接していたことから甚大な被害を受けた長崎の城山小学校を舞台に、原爆で母親を失った3人の少年少女の友情を描く。現地の子どもたちを取材し、その生活風景から物語を着想する方法は、以後、木村の児童映画制作の根幹をなすこととなる。
n長崎の子うなぎとり.synopsis_en: Set at Shiroyama Elementary School in Nagasaki, which suffered devastating damage due to its proximity to the hypocenter, this film depicts the friendship of three boys and girls who lost their mothers to the atomic bomb. The method of interviewing local children and drawing inspiration for the story from scenes of their daily lives would thereafter form the foundation of Kimura's children's filmmaking.

t295357.synopsis: 村に赴任してきた教師の目を通じて、生活の基盤が海と山で異なる2つのグループに住民が分かれ、対立している地域で育つ子どもたちの成長をユーモラスに描く。小学生が主人公の教育映画だが、子どもたちから真に教育を受けるのは旧来の意識にとらわれていた大人たちである。ヴェネチア国際映画祭に出品され、高い評価を得た。
t295357.synopsis_en: Through the eyes of a teacher newly assigned to a village, this film humorously depicts the growth of children raised in a community divided into two opposing groups whose livelihoods are based on the sea and the mountains respectively. Though it is an educational film with elementary school children as protagonists, it is the adults trapped in old ways of thinking who truly receive an education from the children. It was submitted to the Venice International Film Festival and received high acclaim.
t295357.tmdb_overview_en: Focuses on the mutual antipathy of two groups of children in an Izu village.

t3529.director: ウィリアム・S・ヴァン・ダイク
t3529.tmdb_overview_en: A husband and wife detective team takes on the search for a missing inventor and almost get killed for their efforts.

t807.director: デヴィッド・フィンチャー
t807.synopsis_en: Detective Somerset, nearing retirement, and rookie Mills head to a murder scene. There they find the gruesome corpse of a morbidly obese man. Before long, the body of a businessman is discovered as well. From the words left at each scene, Somerset deduces that the killer is committing murders based on the seven deadly sins of Christianity (pride, envy, wrath, sloth, greed, gluttony, and lust), with five remaining. The two rush to identify the killer and prevent further crimes. Eventually a man surfaces as a suspect, but they lose him when they close in, and more victims fall. Then, with only two sin-themed crimes remaining, a man claiming to be the killer turns himself in—but…
t807.tmdb_overview_en: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
t807.tmdb_overview_jp: 定年退職間近の刑事サマセットと新人のミルズは、ある殺人現場に向かう。そこには肥満の大男の凄惨な死体があった。またほどなくして、今度はビジネスマンの死体が発見される。サマセットはそれぞれの現場に残されていた文字から、犯人がキリスト教における七つの大罪(傲慢・嫉妬・憤怒・怠惰・強欲・暴食・色欲)に因んだ殺人に及んでいると分析、残るは5件となった。事件を未然に防ごうと犯人の特定を急ぐ2人。やがて一人の男が容疑者に浮上、しかし接近するも取り逃がし、さらなる犠牲者を出してしまう。そんな中、大罪に沿った犯行が残り2件となったところで、犯人を名乗る男が自首して来るのだが…。

t857736.tmdb_overview_en: Contemporary musical drama film by Yasuzo Masumura.

t480176.tmdb_overview_en: The entangled relations between the son of a seductive tea-ceremony teacher and the women in his father's life. Based on the novel by Kawabata Yasunari.

t193763.synopsis_en: The third installment in Mari Atsumi's 'Mollusk Series.' Yumi, raised purely by her mother alone, is one day violated by her mother's lover, and her enraged mother murders the man before Yumi's eyes. Afterward, Yumi begins working at a downscale bar where her mother was employed, and with her devilish charm she starts bewitching men. Then she meets the manager of a high-class Ginza club and becomes the mistress of its president, but...
t193763.tmdb_overview_en: This Japanese melodrama chronicles the exploits of a geisha's beautiful daughter. The daughter is the geisha's pride and she spares nothing to insure that she has a bright future. But the hard-working young woman's dreams of becoming a dressmaker are shattered.... She then becomes a nightclub hostess who plays cards with male patrons using her body as the prize.
t193763.tmdb_overview_jp: 渥美マリの「軟体動物シリーズ」の第3作。母の手ひとつで純粋に育てられた由美は、ある日母の愛人に犯され、逆上した母は由美の目の前でその男を殺害する。その後、由美は母の勤めていた場末のバーで働き始め、その小悪魔的魅力で男を惑わすようになる。そして、銀座の高級クラブのマネージャーと知り合い、その社長の愛人になるのだが…。

t389052.synopsis_en: A young prosecutor takes charge of the murder case of a food company president. This suspense film depicts his struggle for justice and truth against mass perjury and a cunning, corrupt veteran lawyer.
t389052.tmdb_overview_en: After a businessman is murdered, an investigation identifies a suspect who is then put on trial for that crime.
t389052.tmdb_overview_jp: 食品会社社長殺害事件を担当した若い検事。集団偽証や老悪徳弁護士を相手に、正義と真実を求めて闘う姿を描くサスペンス。

t224158.tmdb_overview_en: Detective Katahachi meets a young and beautiful pickpocket and doesn’t arrest her because she was not in the act. Instead, he listens to the story about her parents who killed himself and died for overwork to feel sorry about her.

t1190669.movie_title: わたしの聖なるインド
t1190669.synopsis: ヒンドゥー至上主義法案への抗議として行われた大規模な座り込み。中心にいたのはムスリムの女性達だった。歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡を描くドキュメント。
t1190669.synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').
t1190669.tmdb_overview_en: Protests rage against the Indian Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA), which persecutes Muslims. The director listens to the voices of the protesters and observes her own identity as a Muslim woman.

t1269644.synopsis: 1945年、終戦間近のドイツ。疎開先の島で12歳の少年ナニングは戦地から戻らぬ父に代わり、家族を支えているが…。少年の目に映る敗戦を描く。
t1269644.synopsis_en: In 1945, at the end of World War II, the island of Amrum in northern Germany remained in a strange, paradise-like stillness even as bombers flew overhead toward the mainland. Naning, a 12-year-old boy evacuated there, supports his pregnant mother and family by helping with farm work in place of his father, who has not returned from the front. However, when his mother Hille, who is devoted to Hitler, collapses both mentally and physically upon receiving news of his death, Naning's daily life is transformed. Hille, drained of vitality and refusing food, desires only one thing: white bread generously spread with butter and honey.
t1269644.tmdb_overview_en: On Amrum Island in spring 1945, twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals, fishes at night, and works the fields to help feed his family. When the war ends, his mother sinks into depression, and he must navigate new conflicts while struggling to find his own path.

nクロードシャブロル傑作選vol2.movie_title: クロード・シャブロル傑作選vol.２
nクロードシャブロル傑作選vol2.movie_title_jp: クロード・シャブロル傑作選vol.２

t1699926.synopsis: 白髪の清掃婦の前に若かりし姿の母の亡霊が現れる…。2019年上演の実験的舞台に、CGパートを加えて映像化した前代未聞の最新作！
t1699926.synopsis_en: A visual work that reimagines "The Woman Who Cleans," a stage piece first performed in 2019 by director Kei Shichiri, known for "Waiting for the Pianist" and "Sleeping Princess." "The Woman Who Cleans," which was Shichiri's first stage work, gained attention as an experimental performance that interwove live bodies with gauze-screen projections (projections onto translucent screens), modeled after the traditional performing art of mugen-noh (dream noh). The work later evolved into a video performance that was among the first to incorporate AI-based motion capture (skeletal extraction) technology, and now a CG segment with non-human choreography has been added to create a new video piece. Before a white-haired woman working as a cleaning lady, the ghost of her mother appears in her youthful form. The mother laments that her daughter lives alone without bearing children, but the daughter strongly refutes her. The cast features accomplished performers in the performing arts. Tomoko Ando, from the legendary troupe "Tenkei Gekijō" and currently leading the theater company "ARICA," plays the white-haired cleaning woman, while dancer and choreographer Ikuyo Kuroda, who has led the dance company "BATIK" and won numerous awards, plays the mother's ghost. Singer Junko Sato handles the vocals and music.
t1699926.tmdb_overview_en: I am a cleaning woman. My hair has turned white, and the days simply pass by without meaning. Then, the ghost of my mother appears before me in her youthful form. She laments that her daughter never bore children and lives in solitude. But the daughter fiercely argues back… A performance of song and physical expression borrowing the form of mugen nō. When it repeats once again, human figures are no longer there. Strange box-like humans writhe and move, and the theater transforms into CGI…

t1457842.director: ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン
t1457842.synopsis: スペイン、バルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。“よき谷”と名付けられたこの場所は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島でありながら、大都市の近くとは思えないほどの豊かな自然に恵まれた理想郷のようでもある。ここには20世紀半ばから移り住んだ住民の家族と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移民たちが共に暮らしている。文化や生活スタイルは異なるものの、子供たちはともに川で遊び、誰もがよく食べて飲んで、歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスに、新しく鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がった。住民説明会が開かれ、一部の人々は立ち退きを迫られるが……。
t1457842.synopsis_en: A new feature film from director José Luis Guerín, who captivated the world with 'In the City of Sylvia' (2007) and was called 'the most outstanding filmmaker in contemporary Spain' by fellow Spanish director Víctor Erice. Despite his sparse output, Guerín continues to create masterpieces that lightly transcend the boundaries between fiction and documentary. This is his long-awaited new film, his first in ten years since 'The Academy of Muses' (2015), now arriving in Japan. To commemorate the release of 'The Good Valley Story,' the beautiful masterpiece 'In the City of Sylvia' will also be revived. Please enjoy Guerín's world on the big screen. The Vallbona district, located on the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. This place, named 'The Good Valley,' is surrounded by rivers and railway tracks, an isolated land left behind by development, yet it also seems like an ideal paradise blessed with nature so rich it's hard to believe it's near a big city. Here, families who moved in from the mid-20th century live together with a new generation of immigrants who have arrived recently. Although their cultures and lifestyles differ, the children play together in the river, and everyone eats, drinks, sings, and dances well, finding a moment of peace. A new railway expansion plan is proposed for this urban oasis. A residents' information meeting is held, and some people are forced to relocate...
t1457842.tmdb_overview_en: In a peripheral neighbourhood, where the rural and urban worlds meet, the houses of the first migrants who arrived after the post-war period coexist with the new blocks of the dormitory city, where the latest wave of migration is concentrated. This humble corner is now an authentic global village. Good Valley Stories is a sum of constructs, of social, generational and identity, urban and ecological conflicts, but it is also a calm and humanistic look at today’s world.
t1457842.tmdb_overview_jp: スペイン、バルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。“よき⾕”と名付けられたこの場所は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島でありながら、⼤都市の近くとは思えないほどの豊かな⾃然に恵まれた理想郷のようでもある。ここには 20 世紀半ばから移り住んだ住⺠の家族と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移⺠たちが共に暮らしている。⽂化や⽣活スタイルは異なるものの、⼦供たちはともに川で遊び、誰もがよく⾷べて飲んで、歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスに、新しく鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がった。住⺠説明会が開かれ、⼀部の⼈々は⽴ち退きを迫られるが……。

t57389.director: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
t57389.synopsis: イタリア最南端、カラブリアの丘の村に暮らす老いた羊飼い。病に侵された彼は、教会の床の塵を水に溶かして飲むという迷信的な治療法に頼っていた。ある晩、「魔法の粉」を使い果たした彼は絶望し、静かにベッドに横たわり、翌朝、眠るように息を引き取る。その後、彼のヤギの群れは新しい牧夫に引き継がれ、その中から1頭の子ヤギが誕生する…。
t57389.synopsis_en: Italian filmmaker Michelangelo Frammartino tells the story of four lives that are born and die. Based on the Pythagorean concept of "four transmigrations," the film presents humans, animals, plants, and minerals with equal weight from a fundamentally egalitarian perspective that does not center the human world. After an elderly shepherd quietly dies in a mountain village in Calabria, southern Italy, his young goat dies beside a large fir tree. The tree is cut down for a village festival and eventually becomes charcoal. With no dialogue and long takes, the film captures nature as it is. In Japan, it screened in the natural TIFF section of the 23rd Tokyo International Film Festival in 2010 and was released theatrically in 2011. It will be released in 2026 as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
t57389.tmdb_overview_en: An old shepherd lives his last days in a quiet medieval village perched high on the hills of Calabria, at the southernmost tip of Italy. He herds goats under skies that most villagers have deserted long ago. He is sick, and believes to find his medicine in the dust he collects on the church floor, which he drinks in his water every day.

t1659897.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t1659897.synopsis: かいせつ マスコミから逃げ出した人気作家(有馬)と、彼女を偶然助けたカメラマン(高橋)とのラブコメ珍道中。漁師を束ねる女親方に扮した沢村が愉快！
t1659897.synopsis_en: A romantic comedy adventure about a popular author (Arima) who flees from the media and the photographer (Takahashi) who happens to rescue her. Sawamura is delightful as the female boss who leads a group of fishermen!

t1235212.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t1235212.synopsis: かいせつ 会社の倒産で失業した若い男女がカレーライス店の開業に奮闘するラブコメディ。大空のバイタリティ溢れるヒロインは魅力的で、沢村はその母役。
t1235212.synopsis_en: A romantic comedy about a young man and woman who lose their jobs when their company goes bankrupt and struggle to open a curry rice restaurant. The heroine, played by Ohzora, is charming with her boundless vitality, and Sawamura plays her mother.

t1560591.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t1560591.synopsis: かいせつ 魅惑的でどこに行っても人を惹きつけてしまう“お手伝いさん”をめぐって起こる騒動を軽やかに描いた大家族コメディ。沢村はヒロインの母役。
t1560591.synopsis_en: A lighthearted big-family comedy depicting the commotion caused by a captivating "housemaid" who attracts people wherever she goes. Sawamura plays the heroine's mother.
t1560591.tmdb_overview_en: A countryside woman working as a maid gets scouted for a model job.

t729442.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t729442.synopsis: かいせつ 戦中戦後の混乱を背景に、薄幸ながら情熱的に生きたひとりの娼婦と、彼女を慕う人々との交流を描いた感動篇。沢村は強烈な教育者役。
t729442.synopsis_en: A moving film set against the turmoil of wartime and postwar Japan, depicting the exchanges between a woman who lived passionately despite her unfortunate circumstances as a prostitute, and the people who adored her. Sawamura plays a fierce educator.
t729442.tmdb_overview_en: Ayako Wakao won the Blue Ribbon and the Kinema Jumpo for this film.

nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.movie_title: セックス・ピストルズ 破壊の設計図
nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.movie_title_jp: セックス・ピストルズ 破壊の設計図
nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.synopsis_en: —1970s London, England— The birth of 'punk rock'— 'That's so punk!'— Its spirit began here. — The Sex Pistols — surely everyone has heard that name at least once. They were a 'punk' rock band that suddenly appeared in late 1970s London, completely rejecting the stagnant rock scene. Today, 'that's so punk' is used in everyday conversation, but that spirit was born here. The original bassist and ill-fated man, Glen Matlock, tells the whole story in this shocking alternative narrative. Featuring live footage and interviews from the era, as well as rare live performances by Glen Matlock. This masterpiece documentary depicts the interplay between truth and falsehood in show business, and between artistic expression and commercialism, while posing the universal question: 'Who is the true winner in life?'

n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.movie_title: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.movie_title_jp: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.synopsis: 1957年に売春防止法が施行されたが、依然として対策が必要であるとの認識から、一般の理解と協力をより深めるべく製作された啓蒙映画。若い坑夫の実（左右田）と東京に出てきたものの街娼に身を落としていたたか子（小沢）は、ドヤ街の一室で自殺を図ったところを間一髪で救われる。やがて、婦人相談員の峰岸（平松）や民生委員の協力を得ながら、たか子は新たな人生へと一歩ずつ前進する。
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.synopsis_en: Produced as an educational film to deepen public understanding and cooperation, recognizing that measures were still needed even after the Anti-Prostitution Act took effect in 1957. A young miner named Minoru (Soda) and Takako (Ozawa), who came to Tokyo but fell into street prostitution, attempt suicide in a room in a flophouse district and are saved at the last moment. Eventually, with the help of a women's counselor named Minegishi (Hiramatsu) and a welfare commissioner, Takako takes one step at a time toward a new life.

n新中国を行くシリーズ.movie_title: 新中国を行くシリーズ
n新中国を行くシリーズ.movie_title_jp: 新中国を行くシリーズ
n新中国を行くシリーズ.synopsis: 1961年に日本テレビで放映されたドキュメンタリーシリーズ。木村は監修を務めた。1953年に中国から帰国した当時、木村は「人民のための中国が逞しく起ち上りつつある」（『キネマ旬報』1953年4月下旬号）と書き、後年には「いまの中国はこうなんだ、本当はこうなんだということを話すには帰る必要があると思って、帰ってきたんですよ」（『講座 日本映画2』岩波書店）とそのときの心境を語っている。本作撮影時の中国は大躍進政策による飢饉に見舞われていたが、完成した作品は、農業の集団化や工業化により、まさに「人民のための中国」が実現したことを喧伝する内容となっている。
n新中国を行くシリーズ.synopsis_en: A documentary series broadcast on Nippon Television in 1961. Kimura served as supervisor. When he returned from China in 1953, Kimura wrote that 'a China for the people is rising up vigorously' (Kinema Junpo, late April 1953 issue), and in later years spoke of his state of mind at the time: 'I thought I needed to go back to talk about what China is really like now, what it's truly like' (Koza Nihon Eiga 2, Iwanami Shoten). At the time of filming, China was suffering from famine caused by the Great Leap Forward policy, but the completed work propagates that 'a China for the people' had indeed been realized through agricultural collectivization and industrialization.
